item.title: Serial stalker of teenagers refused bail after leaving girl 'petrified'
item.description: A serial stalker previously described as “an ongoing risk to young women” has appeared in court after again targeting a teenage girl.

item.title: Man arrested after fire destroys iconic Georgian home
item.description: A 32-year-old man who was arrested on suspicion of arson following a major fire at an historic Tyrone property has been released on bail.

item.title: GP surgeries to temporarily close during computer system switchover
item.description: Patients registered with three local GP practices are being urged to order their prescriptions early ahead of a planned temporary closure.

item.title: Minister views £8 million upgrade to Ballygawley treatment works
item.description: NI Water was delighted to recently welcome Infrastructure Minister Liz Kimmins on site to view the recent completion of an £8 million upgrade at Ballygawley Wastewater Treatment Works (WwTW).

item.title: MLA calls for scrutiny on soaring fuel costs amid global tensions
item.description: An MLA has called for urgent scrutiny of rising home heating oil prices, warning that sharp increases "within 48 hours" has caused "serious concern" for households.

item.title: Slieve Beagh wildfire meeting to take place next week
item.description: A key meeting aimed at tackling the growing threat of wildfires on Slieve Beagh will take place next week as stakeholders move to finalise plans ahead of the fire season.

item.title: Enniskillen woman sentenced for being drunk in-charge of a vehicle
item.description: An Enniskillen woman has been sentenced after being under the influence of alcohol while in charge of a vehicle over the festive period.

item.title: ERGS marks new chapter with arts production celebrating school heritage
item.description: Students at Enniskillen Royal Grammar School have marked a period of change with a Senior Drama production that looked both to the past and the future of the school community.

item.title: Tyrone man in court charged with multiple counts of strangulation
item.description: A case alleging sustained domestic abuse involving separate instances of strangulation over a four-year period has been returned for trial

item.title: Karen turns passion into profession with new cookery business
item.description: After more than 27-years working in aviation, Karen Dodds from Fintona has successfully retrained in cookery at the age of 46 and launched her own food-based business Meadowclere Cookery School following a return to education at South West College
